variants.headline: Home world sends punitive expedition
variants.sub: A punitive expedition has been dispatched by the home world.
variants.body:
The home world has sent a punitive expedition. Dispatch and arrival are different events, and this report establishes only the former. Readers considering {target} should not be asked to accept an invented landing, confrontation or account of force as part of the news of its departure.

Sent does not mean arrived. Remember that before the imagination supplies a scene at the port. The home world has dispatched a punitive expedition. The purpose is serious enough to deserve attention without a fictional confrontation. Readers need clear questions about authority, not a battle that exists only in the telling.

We judge {target} adversely. Punitive power demands an exacting political standard, and the dispatch is an appropriate occasion to question the quality and fairness of the responsibility being exercised. Readers deserve a clear story and a straight answer about responsibility.
